title: Vector B: The Dirt Sweep - Input

sources.title: County data sources (ArcGIS FeatureServer/MapServer query layers)
sources.description: Each entry points at a public county parcel layer's ArcGIS REST `query` endpoint and maps that layer's attribute names onto the engine's normalized fields. Ships with KC-metro defaults; verify each endpoint before a production run.

zoningCodes.title: Target zoning codes (Infill / density)
zoningCodes.description: Zoning codes that permit duplex / multi-family / infill density. Matched case-insensitively as a prefix so 'R-3' also catches 'R-3A'.

infillContextAreas.title: KCMO Infill / Residential Context Area tags
infillContextAreas.description: Optional overlay / context-area values (e.g. KCMO 'Infill Residential Context Area'). If a source exposes a context/overlay field, list its qualifying values here.

contextField.title: Context / overlay attribute name
contextField.description: Optional. The attribute that carries the context-area / overlay tag, if the source layer has one.

vacantOnly.title: Vacant lots / tear-downs only
vacantOnly.description: When on, keep only parcels with no/low improvement value or a vacant/teardown land-use code (the classic infill target).

teardownImprovementCeiling.title: Tear-down improvement-value ceiling ($)
teardownImprovementCeiling.description: Parcels with an improvement value at or below this are treated as tear-down candidates even if not flagged vacant.

vacantLandUseCodes.title: Vacant / tear-down land-use codes
vacantLandUseCodes.description: Land-use code values that mean 'vacant' or 'tear-down' for these counties.

outOfStateOnly.title: Out-of-state owners only
outOfStateOnly.description: Keep only parcels whose owner mailing state is outside the parcel's home state (the high-equity, off-market signal for Target 2 tracts).

minAcreage.title: Minimum acreage
minAcreage.description: Lower acreage bound. Leave at 0 for infill lots. Set to 10 for the exurban tract sweep (Target 2).

maxAcreage.title: Maximum acreage
maxAcreage.description: Upper acreage bound. Leave at 0 for no cap. Set to 40 for the exurban tract sweep.

minEquityProxy.title: Minimum equity proxy ($)
minEquityProxy.description: Keep only parcels whose assessed equity proxy meets this floor. 0 disables the filter.

maxRecordsPerCounty.title: Max records per county
maxRecordsPerCounty.description: Safety cap on records pulled per source (0 = unlimited).

pageSize.title: ArcGIS page size
pageSize.description: Records per ArcGIS request. Most servers cap at 1000-2000.

webhookUrl.title: n8n / CRM webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional. Each qualified lead is POSTed here as JSON for routing into the CRM (Vector B handoff).
